news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹11.76 loss per share (vs ₹1.35 profit in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹11.76 loss per share (down from ₹1.35 profit in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹595.8m (down 60% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹170.6m (down ₹191.2m from profit in 3Q 2025).

news.title: Nibe Limited (BSE:535136) completed the acquisition of an additional 48.95% stake in Nibe Meson Naval Limited from Quest Flow Controls Limited (BSE:543982).
news.body:
Nibe Limited (BSE:535136) agreed to acquire an additional 48.95% stake in Nibe Meson Naval Limited from Quest Flow Controls Limited (BSE:543982) on November 12, 2025. Nibe Limited entered into an agreement to acquire an additional 48.95% stake in Nibe Meson Naval Limited from Quest Flow Controls Limited for INR 0.49 million on November 21, 2025. A cash consideration valued at INR 10 per share will be paid by Nibe Limited. Upon completion, Nibe Limited will own 99.95% stake in Nibe Meson Naval Limited.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Nibe Meson Naval Limited reported net loss of INR 1.25 million.

news.title: Nibe Limited Announces Resignation of Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director Venkateswara Gowtama Mannava, Effective February 6, 2026
news.body: Nibe Limited announced that Mr. Venkateswara Gowtama Mannava resigned as Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director of the Company, with effect from February 6, 2026, citing his personal commitments and pre-occupancy. Consequently, he shall also cease to be a Member of the Audit Committee, Nomination & Remuneration Committee and Chairman of the Stakeholders Relationship Committee of the Company, with effect from the aforesaid date.

news.body: Nibe Limited announced that they will report Q3, 2026 results on Feb 12, 2026

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 6.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Minor Risks Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (6.9% average weekly change). Profit margins are more than 30% lower than last year (4.1% net profit margin).

news.title: Nibe Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 1.036464 billion in funding from Eminence Global Fund Pcc - EUBILIA CAPITAL PARTNERS FUND I, Prosperitas Capital Pte Ltd, North Star Opportunities Fund Vcc - Bull Value Incorporated Sub- Fund and another investor
news.body: Nibe Limited announced a private placement to issue 440,000 shares at an issue price of INR 1,248 for gross proceeds of INR 549,120,000 and 1,562,000 warrants at an issue price of INR 312 per warrant for gross proceeds of INR 487,344,000; aggregate gross proceeds of INR 1,036,464,000 on December 23, 2025. The transaction will include participation from Nibe Ganesh Ramesh 1,001,500 warrants, Eminence Global Fund PCC – Eubilia Capital Partners Fund I 560,500 warrants, Venus Investments VCC – Venus Stellar Fund 232,000 shares and North Star Opportunities Fund VCC – Bull Value Incorporated VCC Sub-Fund 208,000 shares. The transaction has been approved by shareholders.
